description.text: Interpretation: concentrated technology strength alongside weaker broad/cyclical participation reduces confidence in a broad rebound. Bull case: improving demand with easing yield pressure. Bear case: strong activity keeps financing costs elevated. Disconfirmation: improving equal-weight/small-cap participation and sustained lower yields. Review through Oct9; no numerical weekly prediction is validated.

description.text: Research only. Review through Friday 9 October 2026; check new disclosures and complete daily prices before assigning direction or target.
NO TRADE: adjusted price history, executable rules, costs, liquidity and risk limits are not validated. Collect these before paper-trade evaluation.

Compare SPY, QQQ, VTI, DIA, IWM and RSP for broad versus concentrated participation. VXUS has foreign-market and FX exposure; MCHI faces paused onshore price discovery Oct 1–7. MY benchmark ETF quotes are missing.

Secondary market review: the US session ended mixed. AP links fading early gains to stronger growth reports and persistent yield pressure; this is a reported causal account, not independently proven causation.
